en.title: Apple's Record Rally Fuels $328 Target Certainty
en.summary: Apple shares have surged, hitting record territory and adding over $600 billion in market value since June 25. This rally, driven by traders rotating out of AI stocks, has pushed the probability of AAPL hitting $328 by July 2026 to 100%.
drivers: AAPL's record-breaking rally since June 25
Traders fleeing AI stock selloff into Apple
$600-$650 billion added to Apple's market value

en.bull_case: Continued capital rotation into Apple and strong product cycles will easily sustain its record valuation past $328.
en.bear_case: A reversal in AI spending sentiment or broader market correction could quickly erode Apple's recent gains.

market.question: Will Shabana Mahmood be the next Chancellor of the Exchequer of the UK in 2026?

en.title: Mahmood Chancellor Odds Soar Amid UK Crisis
en.summary: The probability of Shabana Mahmood becoming UK Chancellor by 2026 surged by 77.9% to 90% following the suspected murder of former minister Ann Widdecombe. This dramatic shift reflects market speculation that the political instability could hasten a Labour government, positioning Mahmood for a top cabinet role.
drivers: Ann Widdecombe's murder signals severe political instability.
Counter-terrorism investigation heightens UK political crisis.
Increased likelihood of early general election or government change.
Mahmood seen as strong Chancellor candidate in future Labour government.
en.why_matters: The market's reaction highlights how unforeseen political events, even indirectly related, can drastically re-evaluate leadership prospects. This indicates a heightened sensitivity to political stability and potential shifts in power.
en.bull_case: Escalating political instability could force an early general election, leading to a Labour victory and Mahmood's appointment as Chancellor.
en.bear_case: The direct link between Widdecombe's murder and Mahmood's Chancellorship is tenuous, and current government may stabilize or choose another Labour figure.

zh.title: 英国政局动荡，马哈茂德任财相概率飙升
zh.summary: 在英国前大臣安·维德科姆被谋杀后，沙巴纳·马哈茂德在2026年成为英国财政大臣的概率飙升77.9%至90%。这一剧烈变化反映了市场猜测，政治不稳定可能加速工党执政，从而使马哈茂德有望担任内阁要职。
drivers: 安·维德科姆遇害预示严重政治动荡。
反恐调查加剧英国政治危机。
提前大选或政府更迭可能性增加。
马哈茂德被视为未来工党政府财相强有力人选。
zh.why_matters: 市场反应凸显了即使间接相关的意外政治事件，也能剧烈重估领导人前景。这表明市场对政治稳定和潜在权力转移的敏感度极高。
zh.bull_case: 政治动荡加剧可能迫使提前大选，工党获胜后马哈茂德有望被任命为财政大臣。
zh.bear_case: 维德科姆遇害与马哈茂德任财相的直接关联薄弱，现政府可能稳定或工党选择其他人选。

market.question: Will China GDP growth in Q2 2026 be between 4.3% and 4.6%?

en.title: China GDP 2026 Outlook Solidifies
en.summary: The market probability for China's Q2 2026 GDP growth to be between 4.3% and 4.6% surged to 100% following the release of Q2 2024 GDP data showing 4.3% growth. This specific data point, matching the lower bound of the prediction market range, drove the dramatic increase in certainty.
drivers: China's Q2 2024 GDP reported at 4.3%.
This 4.3% figure falls precisely within the market's target range.
Market participants project current growth trends to persist into Q2 2026.
en.why_matters: This market reflects investor confidence in China's medium-term economic stability and growth trajectory. A sustained growth rate around 4.3% would indicate a 'new normal' for the world's second-largest economy.
en.bull_case: China's economy demonstrates remarkable stability, with policy interventions successfully anchoring Q2 2026 growth near the current 4.3% level.
en.bear_case: Unforeseen global economic shocks or domestic structural issues could push Q2 2026 GDP growth outside the 4.3%-4.6% range.

zh.title: 中国2026年GDP展望确定
zh.summary: 中国2026年第二季度GDP增长介于4.3%至4.6%的市场概率飙升至100%，此前公布的2024年第二季度GDP数据显示增长率为4.3%。这一与预测区间下限精确吻合的数据点，极大地提升了市场确定性。
drivers: 中国2024年第二季度GDP增长率为4.3%。
该4.3%的数据恰好落在市场预测区间内。
市场参与者预计当前增长趋势将持续至2026年第二季度。
zh.why_matters: 该市场反映了投资者对中国中期经济稳定和增长轨迹的信心。维持在4.3%左右的增长率将预示着世界第二大经济体进入“新常态”。
zh.bull_case: 中国经济展现出显著稳定性，政策干预成功将2026年第二季度增长锚定在当前4.3%水平附近。
zh.bear_case: 意外的全球经济冲击或国内结构性问题可能使2026年第二季度GDP增长偏离4.3%-4.6%区间。
